title: GORGEOUS, HIGH QUALITY TABLECLOTH - RECOMMENDED
text: GORGEOUS, HIGH QUALITY TABLECLOTH - RECOMMENDED. Beautiful tablecloth with a nice texture.  We are expecting visitors soon and this will be one of the tablecloths that we will use.  It looks much better than in the picture.  My wife, my sister and myself all liked it and liked the color and design a lot.  Nothing here to find fault with.  Whenever something says "machine washable", that's always a good thing.  The description says for "outdoor use", but this is nice enough to use inside and that's where we will probably use it.
